).fetchall()

    available_dates = [d for d, info in dates.items() if info.get("status") == "available"]

leg1_rows = conn.execute(
    "SELECT flight_id, destination, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline' AND origin='LAX'"
).fetchall()

connecting_cities = []
for r in leg1_rows:
    dates = json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}")
    if "2026-09-05" in dates and dates["2026-09-05"].get("status") == "available":
        connecting_cities.append({"flight": r["flight_id"], "via": r["destination"]})
